## Known limitations of this import

- The upstream skills reference `scripts/export-documents.mjs`, `scripts/scaffold-state.mjs` and `scripts/profile-strength.mjs`, a Node 22 plus Typst toolchain with a checked-in dependency bundle. That toolchain is deliberately not vendored: it is an application, not a prompt library, and this repository has no Node CI to keep it honest. Everything the skills do with Markdown works without it. For DOCX and PDF export, clone the upstream repository and run it there.
- The skills expect a `my-documents/` state layer in the user's own working directory, described in `skills/_shared/state-layer.md`. That is the user's data and is not vendored. Run the `get-started` skill, or upstream's `npm run scaffold`, to create it.
- `skills/_shared/` holds shared instructions rather than a skill, so it carries no SKILL.md and is exempt from the per-skill provenance rule.

## Notes

The upstream skills carry 47 links to ../_shared/state-layer.md and further links to ../../guides/ and templates/. Copying only skills/ would leave every one of those links pointing at nothing, so guides/ and templates/ are mapped alongside at the same relative distance and the links resolve unchanged. This is why a manifest source declares a list of paths rather than one subdirectory.
